LanguageData.MT_MortarAutoReloadDesc: Request delivery of the selected shell when ammunition runs low. In Core, reload work is 0 and each delivered round is immediately usable. A mortar support module also loads available physical shells nearby. CE uses its own reload rules. Disabling this stops new automatic supply requests and unattended loading. Already assigned delivery jobs continue.
LanguageData.MT_MortarMixedAmmoReloadBlocked: The loaded and selected shell types differ. Unload the remaining rounds first, or select their current type again.
LanguageData.MT_MortarAmmoSelectDesc: Select the next shell to load. Loaded rounds keep their original type. Use Unload shells first to change the loaded ammunition immediately.
LanguageData.MT_MortarUnloadDesc: Return remaining ammunition as physical items and cancel pending reload requests. Automatic reload is also disabled. Select a new shell and enable it again when ready.
LanguageData.MT_MortarAmmoActionFailed: Cannot change or unload shells now. Check remaining rounds, active reloading, reservations and space for the unloaded ammunition.
LanguageData.MT_MortarNativeCEReloadTip: In CE, select a colonist and right-click to order reloading. CE ammunition and reload rules apply.
